description: Training/evaluation source index for content_head.npz. 'use: train' files' frames (at seconds 't' / 0-based frame numbers 'frame') are the model's training data; 'evaluation_only' files (Mixed examples, hard cases) were only scored, never trained on. Paths are relative to the library root (the folder holding Movies/ and Series/). Rebuild with tools/content_detect_manifest.py + tools/train_content_detector.py.

sampling.then: letterbox bars trimmed; fades / flat frames dropped (content_detect.is_informative)

training.sample_weights: balanced per class and per title group
